name: Cheniere Energy, Inc.
blurb: Cheniere Energy, Inc. is an energy infrastructure company focused on liquefied natural gas (LNG) related businesses in the United States. It owns and operates the Sabine Pass LNG terminal in Louisiana and the Corpus Christi LNG terminal in Texas, along with associated pipelines. The company is a leading U.S. LNG exporter and plays a key role in global natural gas markets.
